source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1939, p. 3 ("Larne: Glenarm South result")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Votes from the Belfast News-Letter (3 June 1939, p. 3), checked against the Belfast Telegraph (2 June 1939, p. 15); unopposed returns and deemed re-elections from the Larne Times (6 May 1939, p. 2).

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1939. Glenarm South was the only contested division; the poll was declared on 2 June and the Unionist candidate won. The uncontested divisions are not named in the retrieved report. Poll date Thursday 1 June 1939 (Ballymena Observer 2 Jun 1939 p. 5; BNL 4 May 1939 p. 13); filed under 1939-06-01, renamed from 1939-05-31 (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026).
